top_signals.title: Iran War Breathes New Life Into Turkmenistan’s $10 Billion Pipeline Dream
top_signals.summary: At an energy forum in Ashgabat in late October, Turkmenistan made an unexpected announcement. After years of delays and speculation that the project would be canceled, the forum audience was told the Turkmenistan-Afghanistan-Pakistan-India (TAPI) gas pipeline had just reached "the outskirts of Herat" and would be "commissioned by the end of 2026." Depending on one's definition of "outskirts" for the northwestern Afghan city, that first claim appears to be true. top_signals.title: Coreweave results spark return of AI enthusiasm
top_signals.summary: Wall Street stocks rallied on Wednesday as stronger-than-expected results from Coreweave revived enthusiasm for AI, helping Nvidia recover some of its recent losses despite mounting scrutiny of its chief executive. The S&P 500 climbed one per cent in early trading, while the Nasdaq Composite jumped 1.5 per cent, putting US stocks on course to recover [...]

top_signals.title: eBPF Rootkits: Why Underground Actors Are Taking Notice
top_signals.summary: Linux eBPF rootkits can hide malicious activity and evade traditional detection methods without loading kernel modules. Flare reveals how these techniques are spreading through underground forums, where threat actors are sharing rootkit source code, tutorials, and exploits targeting Linux systems. [...]
